lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires an atomic counter to increment by exactly 1 per update add a dedicated test asserting the exact before after delta not just that a downstream conflict check works
lessons.text: When a spec requires an atomic counter to increment by exactly 1 per update, add a dedicated test asserting the exact before/after delta, not just that a downstream conflict check works.

lessons.key: ac_gap::every named edge case in spec md needs its own dedicated test even when a more general validation test already covers the same code path indirectly
lessons.text: Every named edge case in spec.md needs its own dedicated test, even when a more general validation test already covers the same code path indirectly.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when spec md names a specific route for a concurrency edge case add a task whenall race test for that exact route not just for the route where concurrency risk is highest
lessons.text: When spec.md names a specific route for a concurrency edge case, add a Task.WhenAll race test for that exact route, not just for the route where concurrency risk is highest.
